replacement_delivery_with_coupon.description: Size replacement, home delivery, customer pays (coupon on replacement product price). Requires customer_address when net payment > 0 and shipping.type is delivery.

return_only_branch.description: Full return, drop-off at branch, no payment. coupon_code omitted.

mixed_return_and_replace.description: One line returned, one line replaced (type becomes mixed).

return_other_reason_free_text.description: Return with reason_id pointing to 'אחר' — reason_text is required in the UI when that reason is selected.

callback_consultation.description: Customer unsure — callback only, no return/replace actions on items.

top_level.wizard: Required. Full session state from the customer flow.
top_level.customer_address: Optional. Required in practice when shipping.type is delivery and customer must pay.
top_level.coupon_code: Optional. Validated via coupon webhook; discount applies to replacement product catalog price (not shipping, not surcharge diff).

wizard.orderId: Required. Same as order ivnum / order_id.
wizard.order: Required. Original order snapshot; items[].price is what customer paid per line.
wizard.choices: Required. One entry per order line the customer acted on.
wizard.shipping: Required. type: delivery | branch | callback; fee in ILS.
wizard.step: Optional. UI step marker (e.g. items, shipping, summary).

choices[].sku: Required. Must match an order item SKU.
choices[].action: Required. return | replace | keep | unsure. Only return and replace affect totals.
choices[].reason_id: Required for return. Index into app_settings.return_reasons.
choices[].selected_size_id: Required for replace. SKU/id of chosen size from sizes webhook.
choices[].size_label: Required for replace. Display label of new size.
choices[].size_price: Required for replace. Catalog price of replacement size (used for payment + coupon).
choices[].size_labs_csqr: Optional. Square meters of original item; used earlier in shipping fee calculation.

shipping.type: delivery = courier (שליח עד הבית); branch = return/replace at store; callback = phone consultation.
shipping.fee: Delivery fee in ILS. Usually 0 for branch and callback.
shipping.branch: Branch details object when type is branch.

customer_address.address: Full address string for courier pickup.
customer_address.email: Optional; passed to PayPlus when generating payment link.

derived_by_server.note: These are computed from wizard — do not send unless you implement your own API.
derived_by_server.amount_to_pay: Product amount due after coupon (max(0, discountedNewPrice - paid) per replace line).
derived_by_server.phone: Today taken from authenticated customer session, not request body.
